description: Fetch an Anvil organization and its PDF templates (casts) and workflows (welds). Provide either its slug or its eid (at least one is required). GraphQL query: organization.

eid.description: Organization eid. Provide this OR slug.

slug.description: Organization slug (from anvil_current_user). Provide this OR eid.

name: anvil_get_organization
title: Get organization
